title: Stockroom
delivery: Local move-in supplies tracker with persistent storage and a browser interface

requirements.description: Create and validate supplies, with duplicate-safe retries
Filter supplies, mark them bought, and reject stale changes
Retain purchases after a server restart
Serve a labeled browser form, filters, status region, and local assets

jobs.goal: Implement the SQLite-backed Python server and public API in server.py. At this stage the UI assets may be absent. Include the documented launch flags, readiness message, and routes.

Build and connect the browser app using only index.html, styles.css, and app.js. Match the approved design and API. Include a form with name, room, quantity; room and status filters; a status region; and the task list.
